slot.brief: Wire stretched by two loads; find new length/elongation using Y = stress/strain, watch area change

stem: A wire of length $L$ and radius $r$ extends by $x$ under load $F$. A wire of the same material, length $2L$ and radius $2r$, is subjected to load $6F$. Its extension is

verdicts.working: Using ΔL = FL/(AY), the second extension is (6F)(2L)/(π(2r)²Y) = 3x.

working:
$x=\dfrac{FL}{\pi r^2Y}$; $x_2=\dfrac{6F(2L)}{\pi(2r)^2Y}=3x$.

Independent check: Using ΔL = FL/(AY), the second extension is (6F)(2L)/(π(2r)²Y) = 3x.
solution:
For the same material, extension is $\Delta L=\dfrac{FL}{AY}$. Thus,
$$x_2=\frac{(6F)(2L)}{\pi(2r)^2Y}=3\frac{FL}{\pi r^2Y}=3x$$
